changes.to: Mobile manipulator: differential-drive platform plus integrated LBR iisy 6-axis cobot (11 or 15 kg arm payload). payload_kg = platform capacity 200 kg (my.KUKA lists rated payload 200 kg for KMR iisy-2; a CR C+ variant lists 100 kg). Re-checked 2026-11-17: KUKA product page opened - platform area 695 x 1120 mm, platform capacity up to 200 kg, cobot payload 11 or 15 kg, max 1.5 m/s, IP54, cleanroom class 3, ESD (ISO 61340-5-1 / ANSI ESD S20.20), SLAM navigation with safety scanners + 3D cameras to 2 m, inductive charging, differential drive; launch press release (17 Jul 2023) opened. Platform height 700 mm and 425 kg total weight and 8 h battery come from KUKA's my.KUKA variant page (KMR iisy-2) as seen in a search excerpt; no KUKA-hosted datasheet PDF was found.
Maker: UL and FCC approval “for the IoT devices” and a TÜV Saar tested MRK system; ESD qualification to ISO 61340-5-1 and ANSI ESD S20.20.
